activity.notes: Shams al-Din Iltutmish succeeded to the Delhi sultanate in 1211 and ruled until 1236. ATLAS reuses the existing Delhi Sultanate polity and records the standard 1211–1236 sultanic reign.

sources.title: A History of Islamic Societies — The Indian subcontinent: The Delhi Sultanates and the Mughal Empire
sources.citation_text: Cambridge's history identifies Iltutmish as ruler of the Delhi Sultanate with a reign of 1211–1236.
